subject: Using only a subset of probes from a genotyping array

messages.author: e34721795d74f63e
messages.subject: Using only a subset of probes from a genotyping array
parts:
Hi,

I'm using a recently published mouse genotypying array. I would like
to exclude some probes from normalization and all subsequent
computations.
I understand I could tinker with annotation files, but is there
another way to use only a specified subset of probes?

Ania Lorenc

messages.author: a5f6afcbe5b17914
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Using only a subset of probes from a  genotyping array
parts:
Hi,

if you with to excluded whole units ("probesets") most normalization
and probe summarization methods support this.

If you wish to exclude specific cells ("probes"), please see thread
'masking probes with aroma' (Sept 23, 2009):

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/d33cc63c524f9bfd?hl=en#

/Henrik
